purpose: Ledger for rev0011 software accountability / attribution-trap lane: cases where software or system state became evidence against people, patients, regulators, or the public while decisive internal state was initially inaccessible to those harmed or responsible for oversight. This is the first machine-testimony ledger slice and includes Therac-25.

rows.accountability_problem: medical-device internal state and overdose path not visible through ordinary patient/operator evidence
rows.visibility_rail: Leveson/Turner retrospective analysis; FDA MDR/MAUDE infrastructure added separately
rows.label: Therac-25

rows.accountability_problem: branch accounting outputs treated as reliable evidence while audit/software state and disclosure were asymmetric
rows.visibility_rail: Bates judgment, Hamilton appeal, statutory Horizon Inquiry
rows.non_equivalence: software plus institutional/legal attribution and redress failure
rows.label: UK Post Office Horizon

rows.accountability_problem: software produced compliant lab-test witness while behaving differently in normal driving
rows.visibility_rail: WVU/ICCT in-use testing, EPA/CARB notice, DOJ/EPA enforcement
rows.label: Volkswagen Dieselgate

rows.accountability_problem: medical-device adverse events need public signal surfaces but passive reports are not causality/rate denominators
late correction memory for machine testimony and institutional denial
rows.visibility_rail: statutory public inquiry and report archive
rows.non_equivalence: public inquiry, not incident-prevention reporting rail

rows.accountability_problem: test-aware software can exploit scripted compliance tests
software opacity creates attribution traps when harmed outsiders cannot inspect decisive internal state

guardrails: Do not infer individual blame without source support.
Do not collapse accidental medical-device harm, wrongful prosecution, and intentional emissions evasion.
Visibility rails are partial; none is treated as a complete denominator or universal software CSB/NTSB.
Use the explicit machine-testimony spelling in future schema work.
